subject: 英语
source: 人教版PEP小学英语（三年级起点）教材单元话题整理
original_text:
【核心词汇】schoolbag 书包; maths book 数学书; English book 英语书; Chinese book 语文书; storybook 故事书; candy 糖果; notebook 笔记本; toy 玩具; key 钥匙
【重点句型】What's in your schoolbag? 你书包里有什么？ An English book ... 一本英语书…… What colour is it? 它是什么颜色？ It's ... 它是……颜色的。 Here it is! 在这儿！
【A Let's talk】Amy: What's in your schoolbag? Zhang Peng: An English book, a maths book and three storybooks. Amy: What colour is it? Zhang Peng: It's blue and white.
【Read and write】I have a new schoolbag. It is black and white. I have an English book, a Chinese book, a maths book and a storybook. I have a candy and a toy. My schoolbag is heavy.
key_points: What's in your schoolbag? 你书包里有什么？
An English book ... 一本英语书……
What colour is it? 它是什么颜色？
